slides.title: What Happened Tuesday, Nov 24
slides.body: Nvidia fell about 5.9% a day after its 31.5% surge. CoreWeave dropped 11.8%. Goldman Sachs said Monday's jump leaned heavily on short covering.

slides.title: The Numbers: Tuesday's Close
slides.body: Nasdaq fell 1.5% to 23,733.54. S&P 500 lost 0.5% to 7,201.09. The Dow rose 0.9%, up 423 points to 50,018.70.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: Futures pricing put the odds of a December Fed rate hike above 90%, Yahoo Finance reported. Higher rates make borrowing costlier for AI builders.
